user_question: Count the hospitals located within each census tract in Centre County.

outputs.summary: Workflow completed with accepted terminal artifacts.

workflow_plan.goal: Count the hospitals located within each census tract in Centre County.

workflow_steps.title: Reproject hospital points to tract CRS
workflow_steps.purpose: Transform hospital point geometries into the projected CRS used by the census tracts so the spatial count can be performed with compatible coordinate systems.
workflow_steps.instructions: Reproject the hospital vector layer to EPSG:26918 and preserve its attributes and point geometries.

workflow_steps.title: Count hospitals within census tracts
workflow_steps.purpose: Compute the number of hospital point features located within each census tract.
workflow_steps.instructions: Count the hospital points from hospitals_projected within the census polygons from input_2. Preserve the tract attributes and add an output count field named hospital_count. Runtime QC must verify the actual spatial coverage and compatible CRS before execution.

requirements.scope: The source CRS of the hospital layer must be known before reprojection.
The hospital input must be supplied in a format accepted by the reprojection worker.
The projected hospital points and census tract polygons must have compatible CRSs for the point-in-polygon count.
Hospital point geometries must be valid for spatial counting.
Census tract polygon geometries must be valid for spatial counting.
The polygon layer used for counting must cover Centre County census tracts requested by the user.
Both spatial inputs must be supplied in GeoPackage format accepted by the point-count worker.

agent_profile_snapshot.name: Projection Agent
agent_profile_snapshot.description: Reprojects vector artifacts between explicitly identified coordinate reference systems and assigns a CRS when explicitly supplied. The service never guesses an unknown CRS.

skills.name: Coordinate Transformation
skills.description: Transforms vector geometry coordinates to a target CRS or defines an explicit CRS on datasets with missing metadata.

constraints.spatial: Reprojection requires a known source CRS and an explicit target CRS. assign_crs requires an explicit CRS to assign.
other: The service does not infer or guess unknown coordinate reference systems.

agent_profile_snapshot.name: Vector Analysis B
agent_profile_snapshot.description: Performs deterministic vector joins, dissolves, grouped aggregations, attribute joins, and buffering. Vector operations consume GeoPackage inputs. The service does not convert formats, repair invalid geometries, or reproject inputs automatically.

skills.name: Vector Aggregation and Joins
skills.description: Performs polygon dissolves, feature aggregations, spatial joins, attribute table joins, and spatial buffering on GeoPackage layers.

constraints.spatial: Requires matching coordinate reference systems for spatial joins. Requires projected CRS for metric buffer.
other: Accepts GeoPackage (.gpkg) vector format only. Rejects GeoJSON or Shapefiles.
Accepts CSV tables for attribute join operations.
